description: Source file implementing shape drawing functions for a graphics library, including functions for shapes like rect, square, line, quad, triangle, ellipse, circle, arc, and point, with external dependencies on Lua and custom graphics modules.

methods.name: beginShape
methods.description: Starts a shape with specified type, defaulting to GL_LINES.

methods.name: vertex
methods.description: Defines a vertex at given x, y coordinates.

methods.name: rect
methods.description: Draws a rectangle with specified position and size, considering rectMode.

methods.name: square
methods.description: Draws a square, a special case of rect.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Draws a line between two points.

methods.name: quad
methods.description: Draws a quadrilateral with four vertices.

methods.name: triangle
methods.description: Draws a triangle with three vertices.

methods.name: ellipse
methods.description: Draws an ellipse or circle based on parameters.

methods.name: circle
methods.description: Draws a circle, a special case of ellipse.

methods.name: arc
methods.description: Draws an arc with specified start and end angles.

methods.name: point
methods.description: Draws a point at specified coordinates.
